desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT community is focused on Russian missile positioning near Ukraine and a US Army soldier’s arrest in the UK on espionage charges tied to Russia. The single most important development is the espionage case, with multiple accounts highlighting counterintelligence partnerships and insider threats.

## MAIN THREADS
### Russian ballistic missiles positioned
- @NOELreports reports Russian monitoring channels claim 20 ballistic missiles are in Bryansk and Rostov regions, with Kyiv and eastern/southeastern Ukrainian bridges as potential targets. [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2120240929135276515)

### Fire at Iranian gas platform
- @hey_itsmyturn reports the SPD14D platform in Southern Pars complex is on fire with personnel evacuated, in Bushehr Province. [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2120239763496292812)

### Ukraine evacuation corridor from Oleshky
- @NOELreports reports Ukraine is preparing another evacuation corridor from Russian-occupied Oleshky after an initial humanitarian mission, pending security agreements. [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2120239576945926340)

### US soldier arrested in UK on Russia-related espionage charges
- @sentdefender reports a US Army soldier arrested in Gloucestershire under the National Security Act 2023 as part of a Russia-linked counter-terrorism investigation involving UK and US agencies. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2120231768544489555)
- @sentdefender quotes FBI Director Kash Patel and Brig. Gen. Sean Stinchon emphasizing the arrest’s importance and increased counterintelligence activity. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2120235676591374726)

### Ukraine security guarantees comment
- @Tendar states that asking Russia for input on Ukraine’s security guarantees is like giving burglars a say in a home security system. [@Tendar](https://x.com/Tendar/status/2120233664772821440)

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- Russian monitoring channels claim 20 ballistic missiles positioned in Bryansk and Rostov (unconfirmed). [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2120240929135276515)
- SPD14D platform in Southern Pars on fire with evacuation (unconfirmed). [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2120239763496292812)
- Additional evacuation corridor from Oleshky under preparation (unconfirmed). [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2120239576945926340)
- Jim Jordan selected as next House Republican Leader (unconfirmed in this context). [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2120238329212109137)

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching for any follow-on Russian missile activity or Ukrainian responses. The espionage investigation’s next developments and any Iranian platform incident updates are also noted.
